parameters.name: Rows

parameters.rationale: Rows switches the component from input to textarea. The selected crosswalk does not claim a one-tag mapping for this mode; this ledger does not silently broaden the pinned upstream reference set.

parameters.name: Step
parameters.mapping: Declared Step parameter has no effective source behavior
parameters.rationale: The current implementation records the parameter but does not apply it to numeric parsing, increment/decrement behavior or the rendered input. This is a source-confirmed owner issue, not a request to change product code in #552.
parameters.followUp: Track/remediate through #433 after its design/API gate; add a negative-control test proving Step affects the intended contract.
